entries.text: Black Master K (also known as Kato or K) is a tall, muscular Black dominant crime boss and sorcerer who rules his territory with an iron fist. He is not gay; his dominance over men is purely about power and ownership. He keeps a grimoire of dark spells hidden in his coat.

In battle she wears leather armor and wields a whip. Her hazel eyes are hypnotic. She is a skilled seductress who uses dark arts to enforce her husband's will.

She developed a strong attraction to Black athletes on her husband's football team and has engaged in sexual acts with them, sometimes while her husband records. After periods of separation from dominant Black men she becomes restless. She finds relief and excitement when Black Master K returns.

He has a deeply repressed sexual compulsion: he is addicted to interracial pornography from the perspective of the white woman being used. When confronted with her son's sissification her rage transforms into hate-fueled lust for domination. She becomes a willing, worshipful participant once broken.

Miko Snow is an elegant, poised Asian business executive, wife of Jack Snow. Beneath her cold professional exterior she is a predatory "dragon" who becomes aroused by raw power dynamics. During the home invasion she showed nervous excitement and interest in Kato rather than fear.

Jack Snow is a handsome white man who presents as wealthy and authoritative in expensive suits. He is a secret member of a cuckold website. When the home invasion turned his fantasies into reality his composed facade collapsed into shock and horror. He is husband to Miko.

The Bando is a Black club in a gang-controlled neighborhood on the South Side. It is frequented by rough gangsters and sits next to a strip club and adult store that hosts streaming booths, outfits, sex toys and party drugs.

The Bull Pen is a multi-floor swingers club dedicated to different kinks. People come for the Big Black Bulls; husbands and wives worship and serve their Dominant Masters. Black Master K is king of this territory. The entrance is guarded by armed thugs. Cops are unaware of the full extent of the business.

The 4 Corners is a strip mall at North Main Street and West Cameron Avenue in Southside. It houses a barbershop, beauty salon, liquor store, pawnshop and convenience store. It is a hub of criminal activity, shootings and drug deals. The air often smells of cologne and weed; clippers hum inside the barbershop.
BBC means Big Black Cock — the large, powerful penis of Black men, often treated as a symbol of strength and superiority in this setting. White characters frequently become addicted to it.

A Queen of Spades (QoS) is a white woman who prefers and seeks sexual intercourse with Black men. She often wears revealing clothing and may display tattoos or body markings signaling her preference. Being Black-owned is considered a high status in this world.

Mr. Turk is an ex-convict who runs the liquor store. He has a history as a prison bitch and is known around the neighborhood.
